description: Author role: read the questions on the run, with their `q_id`s. This is how you learn what you are being asked — you do NOT need them relayed to you as text, and there is something here to answer BEFORE the reviewer has asked anything: the standing set is seeded at compute_diff, so call this as soon as you have read the spine rather than waiting for a batch. Call it with the `run_id` (derive it yourself from compute_diff, or take the one you were given, they are the same value), answer with `answer_questions` using the ids it returns, then call it again with `only_unanswered: true` to confirm nothing was missed. Paged: follow `next_cursor` until there is none.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit to start at the beginning.

max_bytes.description: Byte budget for this page. Defaults to the server's ceiling.

only_unanswered.description: Only questions with no answer yet — what is still owed. Use this after a batch to check you covered everything.

name: get_questions
